title: D3D12 SDK install script does not see MinGW installation on Linux and skips WinPixEventRuntime configuration
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.beta 80a219a58

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (80a219a58) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 575.64.05) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm on Linux and `install_d3d12_sdk_windows.py` is saying it can't detect MinGW for cross-compilation (I do have it installed, I just made a build):

```
[2/3] WinPixEventRuntime
Downloading WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 ...
Extracting WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 to bin/build_deps/pix ...
MinGW wasn't found, so only MSVC support is provided for WinPixEventRuntime.
WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 installed successfully.
```

For reference, running this script on Linux is useful for cross-compilation purposes (and is therefore only relevant with MinGW, not MSVC).

bruvzg said:

> It seems to be looking specifically for `x86_64-w64-mingw32-dlltool`, but some MinGW packages have it without the prefix (simply dlltool).
>
> Or it's missing `gendef`, I have MinGW installed on macOS but `gendef` is not in path.

The assertion about `gendef` is correct: installing `mingw-w64-tools` will make `gendef` available in `PATH`, and running the script again will configure WinPixEventRuntime for MinGW:

```
[2/3] WinPixEventRuntime
Downloading WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 ...
Removing existing local WinPixEventRuntime installation in bin/build_deps/pix ...
Extracting WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 to bin/build_deps/pix ...
Adapting WinPixEventRuntime to also support MinGW alongside MSVC.
 * [./bin/x64/WinPixEventRuntime.dll] Found PE+ image
 * [./bin/ARM64/WinPixEventRuntime.dll] Found PE+ image
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-dlltool: Can't create .lib file: ./bin/ARM64/libWinPixEventRuntime.a: invalid bfd target
WinPixEventRuntime 1.0.240308001 installed successfully.
```

However, `gendef` is not strictly required to build Godot itself, so perhaps we should find another way to detect whether MinGW is available on the current system, or at least better document this requirement.

### Steps to reproduce

- Run `misc/scripts/install_d3d12_sdk_windows.py` on Linux with MinGW installed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
